question: Who among the following was the recipient of the ‘Vatayan Lifetime Achievement Award 2020’?
solution: The correct answer is __Ramesh Pokhriyal.__ __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** • Ramesh Pokhriyal Nishank has been awarded the Vatayan Lifetime Achievement Award 2020. • Owing to his contribution to the field of literature the organization has awarded him with the worthy Award. • He has presented the award through an online ceremony held in the presence of Mira Kaushik, Chairman Vatayan.
